grammar.summary: 本课学习表"驯化"的 tame 与 attach...to。

points.title: attach A to B 表系缚
points.explanation: The elephant is attached to a tree. attach...to = 把A系在B上。驯象叙事的物理动词。

examples.en: The calf is attached to its mother by a rope.
examples.cn: 幼象用绳子系在母象身边。

points.title: 表"接受训练"的 be trained to do
points.explanation: Elephants are trained to work. 被动训练叙事：be trained + 不定式表目的。

examples.en: They are trained to obey commands.
